name: Listen Live Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Listen to your show's audio in the FPP UI. Frame-exact playback uses FPP's MultiSync clock with raw PCM blocks scheduled by Web Audio; playback auto-starts with FPP and the best-effort MP3 fallback streams the current media file before live capture. Includes live status and volume control. Audio stays on your LAN.

privacy.summary: Reads FPP's current media file or its own audio-output monitor on the FPP host and streams it to your browser on your home LAN so you can hear what the audience hears. No microphone or camera is accessed; nothing is uploaded or sent to the internet.

systemChanges.what: Sets FPP's restartFlag on install/uninstall so fppd reloads the native sync plugin

privacy.other: Camera and microphone access: none. The browser never requests microphone or camera permission, and the live-capture fallback reads only FPP's own audio output (PipeWire/PulseAudio monitor or ALSA loopback) on the host — not a mic input. Settings are stored by FPP in <mediadir>/config/plugin.fpp-ListenLive (not in the plugin directory); a legacy config/settings.json is migrated to <mediadir>/plugindata/fpp-ListenLive on install. Audio is served only to browsers on your LAN, and logs go to <mediadir>/logs/plugin-fpp-ListenLive.log. Your browser keeps its volume and Exact-sync toggle preferences in localStorage; mute is never saved.
